fusions.name: Pack Rush
fusions.desc: Rushes to an enemy up to 6 tiles away and swings, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Worrying Bite
fusions.desc: Worries at an open wound for 8 damage, leaving the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Fetch It Back
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Woodsman's Hound
fusions.desc: A bonded hound fights beside you, biting an enemy within 4.5 tiles every 1.2 seconds for 4 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.
